english.toefl: 100 old scale accepted through end of 2027; 5 new scale
english.note: PTE 68 also accepted; TOEFL MyBest accepted. Exemptions: qualifying non-online 2-/4-year US or specified English-country degree before start, ECFMG certification, or GRE Verbal at 50% or above (as written). GSBS rules differ from GSAS Biology.

applicationFee.note: Conditional Tufts affiliation, recruiting-event or qualifying-program routes through portal, with proof. No citizenship restriction stated for these routes; international applicants must confirm eligibility. Hardship route excludes international applicants and is limited to US citizens/nationals/permanent residents. Email requests not processed.

documents: Academic statement of purpose, maximum 750 words
Transcripts or required evaluations for completed/in-progress postsecondary degrees
requirements.note: Optional additional-information essay 250 words. Foreign degrees, including Canada, require official NACES course-by-course evaluation sent directly; final official transcripts required before matriculation. No PhD enrollment deposit stated. Master's not required. Research strongly preferred, not required; competitive preparation includes biology/related degree, genetics, biochemistry, cell biology, organic chemistry, physics, calculus and basic microbiology. Select MERGE-ID in application for that track; others reviewed under core/Molecular Genetics. Three first-year laboratory rotations.

funding.note: Full-time Basic Science PhD support includes tuition scholarship, stipend/research assistantship, health insurance and fees except Student Activity Fee; rare self-funded students exist. Tuition charged/scholarship awarded first five years. No separate school aid form. Future stipend not established.

tracks: MERGE-ID (Medically-Oriented Research in Graduate Education on Infectious Disease)

timeline.interviews: Selected applicants invited to in-person interviews; no current dates stated.
